intro.title: How secure is your self-hosted instance?
intro.lead: Enter the URL and pick the application or let SecCheck detect it. The scanner checks the certificate, TLS configuration, security headers, exposed files, versions and known vulnerabilities. All checks are read-only and run without logging in.
setup.consent: I operate this instance or am explicitly authorized to test it.
scan.urlMissing: Please enter the URL of the instance.
scan.consentMissing: Please confirm that you are allowed to test this instance.
scan.detectNone: No known application detected – “Other web application” selected.
scan.disconnected: The connection was closed before the scan finished.
report.acceptHint: The finding stays visible but no longer counts towards the grade of this target, also in future scans.
report.unacceptHint: The finding counts towards the grade again.
diff.firstHint: From the next scan on you will see here what is new and what was fixed.
fixes.title: Config snippets
fixes.hint: Fixes the header and TLS findings of this scan. Review before applying and adjust the domain names.
common.copyUnsupported: Copying is not supported by this browser.
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.lead: All scanned instances. Instances with a schedule are re-checked automatically; regressions are reported via the notifications in the settings.
history.name: Name
history.deleteConfirm: Really delete? The history will be lost
chart.label: Score history over {count} scans, currently {score} of 100
settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Notifications for scheduled scans (new problems, worse grade) and for new vulnerabilities in your systems.
settings.publicUrl: Address of this scanner (for links in notifications, optional)
settings.language: Language of scheduled scans and notifications
settings.secretsNote: Credentials are stored in the scanner's data directory (SQLite) and are never sent back to the browser.
ntfy.title: ntfy
ntfy.hint: Push messages via ntfy.sh or your own ntfy server.
gotify.title: Gotify
gotify.hint: Messages to a Gotify server (app token from Gotify → Apps).
pushover.title: Pushover
pushover.hint: Push messages via pushover.net. Critical findings are sent with high priority (also during quiet hours).
email.title: Email
md.title: Security report: {target}
md.footer: Created with SelfHost SecCheck – automated outside-in assessment, not a penetration test.
footer: Results are an automated outside-in assessment and do not replace a penetration test.
meta.description: Security checks for self-hosted software: TLS, certificate, headers, versions and app-specific checks.
cve.title: Vulnerabilities
cve.lead: The latest CVEs and security advisories for the software you run, matched against the versions SecCheck detected in your scans or that you entered in the watchlist.
cve.sources: Sources: GitHub Security Advisories, OSV, NVD, CISA KEV, FIRST EPSS
cve.updatingFirst: The first update can take a few minutes: without an API key the NVD allows only a few requests per minute.
cve.noSystems: Nothing to monitor yet. Scan an instance, or add software to the watchlist below.
cve.versionUnknown: version unknown – scan again or add it to the watchlist
cve.possibleHint: “Possibly”: Linux distributions often ship security fixes without changing the version number. Check whether your package contains the fix.
cve.addHint: For software SecCheck cannot scan or whose version is hidden, e.g. your reverse proxy, hypervisor or SSH server.
cve.label: Name (optional)
cve.versionInvalid: Please enter a version number, e.g. 1.26.2.
cve.emptyAffected: None of your systems is affected by a known vulnerability.
cve.kevTitle: Actively exploited: in CISA's catalog of known exploited vulnerabilities since {date}
cve.epssTitle: Probability of exploitation within 30 days (FIRST EPSS). Higher than {percentile} of all CVEs.
settings.cveHint: Notify when a newly published vulnerability affects one of your systems, or when a known one starts being actively exploited (always reported). Uses the channels below.
